title: Replace current VS logo image with newly uploaded image

requirements.text: Add the user-uploaded image `IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png` as a static asset under `frontend/public/assets/generated` (standardized/optimized for web use) and replace the currently used VS logo image (`/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`) with this new asset everywhere the logo is rendered (at minimum: the header logo in `SiteHeader` and the hero logo in `HomePage`).

quotes:
Remove VS image 
Place above image

acceptanceCriteria: A new static image file derived from `IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png` exists under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and is referenced via an `/assets/generated/...` URL.
`frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx` no longer renders `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`; it renders the new uploaded image asset instead.
`frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx` no longer renders `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`; it renders the new uploaded image asset instead.
The new logo renders correctly on both desktop and mobile layouts without distortion (keeps aspect ratio) and without layout shifts in the header or hero sections.

requirements.text: Verify there are no remaining references in the frontend codebase to `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` (or any previous VS logo image) for primary branding, so the uploaded image is the only logo shown to customers.
acceptanceCriteria: Searching the frontend source for `vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` returns zero matches (or only legacy/commented references not used at runtime).
Previewing key pages (Home, Services, Track Status, Register, My Requests, Admin Login) shows the new uploaded logo in the header consistently.

constraints: Do not serve images from the backend; all logo assets must be static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated`.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Changing service category images or category mappings.
Any backend (Motoko) changes or data migrations.
Redesigning the overall site theme beyond swapping the logo image.

required: Optimize the uploaded logo image with transparent/white background preserved, centered composition, and export as a web-optimized PNG (IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png > IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.dim_512x512.png)
